question: Onam is an annual Hindu festival with origins in the state of ______ in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Onam__ is an annual Malayali harvest festival celebrated in the Indian state of Kerala. 
 
• It is the official festival of the state. 
 
• Onam commemorates King Mahabali and Vamana.
 
• A few events are performed during Onam celebrations: Vallam Kali (boat races), Pulikali (tiger dances), Pookkalam (flower rangoli), Onathappan (worship), Onam Kali, Tug of War, Thumbi Thullal (women's dance), Kummattikali (mask dance), etc.​
